newsitem.title: PANAMA: Campbell signs Panama mining contracts.
newsitem.headline: Campbell signs Panama mining contracts.

text.p: A subsidiary of Canadian mining company Campbell Resources Inc signed a 20-year gold mining contract with the Panamanian government.
Vernon Smith, general manager of Minera Cerro Quema, said the contract was signed Friday with the Commerce Ministry and production is expected to start by the second quarter of 1998.
The company plans to invest some $30 million for the 9 million metric ton, open pit mine located some 210 miles (335 km) from Panama City in the south-central province of Los Santos.
Smith estimated there was about 50,000 ounces of recoverable gold per yer over a six-year mine life by using an open pit, heap leaching process.
